arguments.name: command
arguments.summary: one declared command name, or `all`; a bare invocation is refused

arguments.name: --json
arguments.summary: emit the machine-readable document: the run document for a step run or `all`, and the listing document for `list` or `--list`; `--explain` and `--help` print text

arguments.name: --network
arguments.summary: declare that the network is available; a declaration, not a probe

arguments.name: --explain
arguments.summary: print the declared prerequisites, establishment and non-claims; takes precedence over running a command

arguments.name: --list
arguments.summary: print the command set as tab-separated name, role and all-membership (or, with `--json`, the listing document); takes precedence over every other argument

arguments.name: --tmp
arguments.summary: use this directory as the temporary root instead of a fresh one

arguments.name: --help
arguments.summary: print the usage message and exit 0

commands.summary: print each command's prerequisites, delegate, establishment and non-claims, so the interface documents itself

determinismRule.rule: two runs of a command emit the same deterministic record; the declared `environment` and `private_state` blocks are inputs, required to be present and populated, and are not compared

jsonProbe.note: `authority` without --network is NOT_RUN, which still emits a complete document and exits 1; it therefore costs nothing and depends on no candidate state

listJson.note: `--json` is honoured on the listing: `--list --json` and `list --json` emit the listing document (A25 D2 repaired)

0.meaning: every selected required step is PASS; a single requested step gates on itself and must be PASS

1.meaning: at least one selected step is not PASS: FAIL, BLOCKED or NOT_RUN. NOT_RUN is never a pass

2.meaning: the invocation was refused before any step ran: an unknown subcommand, a malformed argument list, or a surface that cannot be read

exitCodeProbes.note: the discovery listing; exercises the parser and exits 0
`all` is recognised as a command token by the same special case the run path uses
a single optional step gates on itself: with no network declared it is NOT_RUN and the run exits 1. No step executes
an unknown subcommand is refused before any step runs
an option missing its value is refused by the parser
explaining an undeclared command is refused
the discovery command as a real subcommand; exercises the repaired D1 dispatch and exits 0

privateStateRule.rule: the surface reads no private state; each command declares the gitignored roots its own delegate may read, and the document reports which of those roots exist and how many untracked or ignored entries each holds. The audited root set is the interface's known roots plus every declared read, so a declared path cannot lie outside presence reporting. Presence is never evidence

levels.deprecated: still executable; a replacement is named and removal happens at the next schema version
levels.experimental: may change without notice; do not program against it
levels.stable: the command name, arguments, exit codes and JSON fields will not change incompatibly within this schema version; a change needs a new schemaVersion and a recorded migration

stabilityRule.supportRule: every level needs `since` and an evidence path that exists; `stable` also needs the surface's support tests to exist in the declared test file
